name: 韭研公社账号时间线
description: 抓取某个韭研公社作者主页的最新文章列表。需要微信登录态。

inputs.name: uid
inputs.description: 作者主页路径 /u/<hash> 中的 hash（在文章页点作者名可得）

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500));for(let y=0;y<=document.body.scrollHeight;y+=700){window.scrollTo(0,y);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120));}window.scrollTo(0,0);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));const arts=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/a/"]')];const seen=new Set();const posts=[];for(const a of arts){if(posts.length>=(Number('$limit')||15))break;const href=a.getAttribute('href')||'';const url=location.origin+href;if(seen.has(url))continue;seen.add(url);const t=(a.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();if(t.length>3)posts.push({title:t.slice(0,120),url:url});}return {ok:true,count:posts.length,posts:posts};})()

body.note: 滚动触发懒加载后抓取文章流
